comment: The Info docker leads with Document, Colour space, Active layer and Selected colours, and Build, Input, History and GPU sit under one Performance fold that opens closed. A document of three layers and a picked colour fill the four sections. The docker is shown alone at the 500 by 520 every layout gives it, with the fold closed, then the fold is pressed open and photographed again. Last, the Useful layout is loaded and photographed with Info closed and the minimap still open. The dump's info_docker block marks each fold section folded or not.
